title: Augusta's 'haunted' landmarks take center stage in YouTube documentary
excerpt: Augusta’s history, hauntings and local legends are taking center stage in a new ‘Unknown’ episode on YouTube.
content:
AUGUSTA, Ga. (WRDW/WAGT) - Augusta’s history, hauntings and local legends are taking center stage in a new ‘Unknown’ episode on YouTube.

Sozo Bear Films’ documentary web series Unknown explores unexplained stories, local legends and mysterious encounters across Georgia.

The new episode is titled “Unknown Georgia: UFOs, Hatman, & Ghosts from Macon to Augusta.” It follows Georgia’s Fall Line from Macon to Augusta.

The filmmakers spent the night at the reportedly haunted Partridge Inn.

They also explored reported paranormal activity at the historic Gertrude Herbert Institute of Art.

The crew traveled along the Augusta Canal to Sibley Mill, where a tragic local legend continues to linger.

“Augusta has no shortage of stories that sit at the intersection of history, mystery and legend,” said Karen Lee Davis, chief marketing officer of Destination Augusta.

The episode also documents reported UFO sightings in Macon, mysterious figures and paranormal encounters along the Fall Line.

You can watch “Unknown Georgia: UFOs, Hatman, & Ghosts from Macon to Augusta” now on the Sozo Bear Films YouTube channel.
